answer.explanation: The visible log events show no errors, timeouts, throttling, or permission failures. All four functions complete with consistent durations: Compression about 500-600 ms, Thumbnailer about 90-170 ms, Uploader about 75-200 ms, CrudApi about 25-55 ms. Max memory used stays well below allocation (Compression about 97-118 of 1024 MB, Thumbnailer about 106 of 1024 MB, Uploader about 96-97 of 256 MB, CrudApi about 91 of 256 MB). The 1024 MB sizing of Compression and Thumbnailer is generous but consistent and not an anomaly. Confidence is limited because 4375 events were truncated and no investigation tools were available, so only the visible events were analysed.
